description: What needs attention across all the person's tracks: hacks that stopped matching their senders' messages (the sender probably changed its emails), messages waiting in each Inbox, sheets TrackerHacker lost access to, and this week's failures. Good for a scheduled check. Each problem says what to do next. suggestions, which aren't problems, name columns a hack could fill but leaves empty (often a column a new minor version of the schema added): offer them to the person.
name: check_tracks
title: Check what needs fixing
